title: Find the product descriptions of items purchased in August 2012 by customer
question: Find the product descriptions of items purchased in August 2012 by customers who use EUR and have a consumption greater than 500 in that same month. Only include transactions that occurred at gas stations located in the Czech Republic.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT P."XCL_009"
FROM transactions_1k AS T
INNER JOIN customers AS C ON T."XCL_013" = C."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN products AS P ON T."XCL_016" = P."XCL_008"
INNER JOIN gasstations AS G ON T."XCL_015" = G."XCL_004"
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS Y ON C."XCL_001" = Y."XCL_019"
WHERE C."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
  AND Y."XCL_020" = '201208'
  AND Y."XCL_021" > 500
  AND T."XCL_011" LIKE '2012-08%'
  AND G."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
